title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: The scan that came back after being released
summary: Turning the Remove unused quick fixes off releases the project scan they hold. The scan running at that moment finished a few seconds later and put all of it straight back.

highlights.title: The memory really goes
highlights.description: A scan in flight now checks the setting before writing its result, and so does the import list built from it.

highlights.title: No deletion without a listing
highlights.description: A quick fix computed across that same moment is no longer offered. Nothing vouches for an absence there, and these actions delete code.

sections.heading: Fixes
bullets: The project scan takes seconds, one round trip per file, so switching the setting off while it runs is ordinary rather than a corner case.
Both caches, the sources and the imports derived from them, now follow the setting at the moment they are written.
